name: IEC 60309 16 A 3P+N+E 6h (red)
description: Industrial pin-and-sleeve accessory with three phases, neutral and earth, 16 A, colour-coded red for 346–415 V. The earth contact sits at the 6 h position of the clock system, aligned with the major keyway.

notes: The socket-outlet and connector face is drawn from the Mennekes front-view figures (earth at 6 h, then L1, L2, L3, N clockwise; contact tubes of sockets and connectors arranged clockwise as viewed from the front), consistent with the Wikipedia caption 'clockwise from bottom: PE, L1, L2, L3, N'. Contact angles and pitch-circle diameter are not dimensioned by these sources (schematic drawing).

No plug or appliance-inlet drawing: no cited source depicts the pin face with the contacts identified (sources only state that the pins are arranged the opposite way, which would mean deriving the face by mirroring).
The IEC 60309-2 standard sheets were not reviewed; ratings come from a manufacturer datasheet.
